sloka: सत्यमेतद्रघुश्रेष्ठ यद्ब्रवीषि हनूमतः ।न बले विद्यते तुल्यो न गतौ न मतौ परः ।। ७.३५.१५ ॥
transliteration: satyametadraghuśreṣṭha yadbravīṣi hanūmataḥ ।na bale vidyate tulyo na gatau na matau paraḥ ।। 7.35.15 ॥

translations.english: O best of Raghus, what you say about Hanuman is true: there is no one equal to him in strength, speed, or intellect.
